mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Area High School and a waning gibbous moon. You can catch the International Space Station passing overhead at 5:05 AM, rising over Middleton near the high school and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot.

The city continues its engineering services contract with AECOM, providing regular updates to the City Council. Additionally, WisDOT is hosting public meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather community feedback on design concepts.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, a meal at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, the community is celebrating with the Main Street Trick or Treat event and Hop Haus trivia.

In a report covering October 18 through October 25, officers handled various calls. Notably, on October 25, a 40-year-old man was arrested for O W I after being found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
